package.description: QUICKSURFACE is the most effective 3D Reverse engineering software for Hybrid modeling on the market

en-US.description: QUICKSURFACE is the most effective 3D Reverse engineering software for Hybrid modeling on the market
en-US.longDescription:
QUICKSURFACE is the most effective 3D Reverse engineering software for Hybrid modeling on the market

- Scan your product with any 3D Scanner that can export STL, OBJ or PLY meshes or PTX point clouds
- Use QUICKSURFACE tools to reconstruct the free form or parametric CAD surfaces and to remodel them to your needs
- Export in industry standard STEP or IGES file format to other CAD/CAM packages or use your results for 3D Printing or CNC machining
en-US.name: QUICKSURFACE 2025
